description: This module allows Configuring Intel Optane Persistent Memory modules (PMem) using ipmctl and ndctl command line tools.

parameters.name: appdirect
parameters.description: Percentage of the total capacity to use in AppDirect Mode (0-100). Create AppDirect capacity utilizing hardware interleaving across the requested PMem modules if applicable given the specified target. Total of appdirect, memorymode and reserved must be 100.

parameters.name: appdirect_interleaved
parameters.description: Create AppDirect capacity that is interleaved any other PMem modules. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: memorymode
parameters.description: Percentage of the total capacity to use in Memory Mode (0-100).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: This enables to set the configuration for the namespace of the PMem.

parameters.name: namespace_append
parameters.description: Enable to append the new namespaces to the system. The default is false so the all existing namespaces not listed in namespace are removed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: Percentage of the capacity to reserve (0-100). reserved is not mapped into the system physical address space and is presented as reserved capacity with Show Device and Show Memory Resources Commands. reserved is set automatically if this is not configured.

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: This enables to set the configuration for each socket by using the socket ID. Total of appdirect, memorymode and reserved must be 100 within one socket.

examples:
- name: Configure the Pmem as AppDirect 10, Memory Mode 70, and the Reserved 20 percent.
  community.general.pmem:
    appdirect: 10
    memorymode: 70

- name: Configure the Pmem as AppDirect 10, Memory Mode 80, and the Reserved 10 percent.
  community.general.pmem:
    appdirect: 10
    memorymode: 80
    reserved: 10

- name: Configure the Pmem as AppDirect with not interleaved 10, Memory Mode 70, and the Reserved 20 percent.
  community.general.pmem:
    appdirect: 10
    appdirect_interleaved: false
    memorymode: 70

- name: Configure the Pmem each socket.
  community.general.pmem:
    socket:
      - id: 0
        appdirect: 10
        appdirect_interleaved: false
        memorymode: 70
        reserved: 20
      - id: 1
        appdirect: 10
        memorymode: 80
        reserved: 10

- name: Configure the two namespaces.
  community.general.pmem:
    namespace:
      - size: 1GB
        type: pmem
        mode: raw
      - size: 320MB
        type: pmem
        mode: sector

return_values.name: reboot_required
return_values.description: Indicates that the system reboot is required to complete the PMem configuration. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: Shows the value of AppDirect, Memory Mode and Reserved size in bytes. If socket argument is provided, shows the values in each socket with socket which contains the socket ID. If namespace argument is provided, shows the detail of each namespace. Returned: success Sample: [{"appdirect": 111669149696, "memorymode": 970662608896, "reserved": 3626500096, "socket": 0}, {"appdirect": 111669149696, "memorymode": 970662608896, "reserved": 3626500096, "socket": 1}]

return_values.name: appdirect
return_values.description: AppDirect size in bytes. Returned: success

return_values.name: memorymode
return_values.description: Memory Mode size in bytes. Returned: success

return_values.name: namespace
return_values.description: The list of the detail of namespace. Returned: success

return_values.name: reserved
return_values.description: Reserved size in bytes. Returned: success

return_values.name: socket
return_values.description: The socket ID to be configured. Returned: success
